findings: Trail is invisible in practice: in packages/games/bomber-20261101/assets.ts drawTrail, the 20-point cap with 16ms spacing keeps only about 0.3s of history, so the line is only a few px long. Keep the 1px/alpha 0.6 to 0 fade but record points by distance or time (e.g. one point per movement step or ~100ms) while still keeping 20 points, so the trail covers 1-2 cells behind a moving bomber.

Points are only added when the player moves but old ones are only expired by age; make a stationary player's trail clearly vanish by aging with fx.time and not adding the live head segment at full alpha when still.

Pure cosmetic: it does not change what a player does or decides. Make the trail contrast with the green floor (e.g. brighter or lighter colour than the player colour, drawn before the player body) so rivals' movement direction is readable.
